roles.reviewer: Claude Code Opus High; complete-source read/review, no direct write prerequisite
roles.publisher: ChatGPT, including honestly attributed Claude reports
roles.human_approver: Named human approver; approval and final acceptance are separate decisions

stop_rule: Stop on manual stop, missing required input, unverified approval, ownership conflict, unknown/pending counters, exhausted time/launch/review/correction limits, repeated no progress, quota/authentication failure or missing required result evidence. Preserve partial output and counters; no account switching or paid API fallback.
resume_rule: Read current Jira status and native dependencies; verify owner and authority, unchanged source versions and durable consumed/reserved counts. Resolve transient faults within unchanged limits. A substantive/manual stop or a cap/scope increase requires recorded authority. Never reset counts by restarting, copying a folder or splitting a ticket.
